gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.231694 41.147108)',4326)::geography, 3500)
  AND p.amenity = 'cafe'
  AND elev.z >= 200;

  FROM pois

cafe_candidates AS (
  SELECT 
    p.poi_name,
    p.geometry::geometry AS geom,
    ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, wr.geom::geography) AS distance_meters
  FROM pois p
  CROSS JOIN wellington_reservation wr
  WHERE p.amenity ILIKE 'cafe'
    AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, wr.geom::geography) <= 3500
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.poi_name,
    cc.distance_meters,
    ST_Value(r.rast, cc.geom) AS elevation_meters
  FROM cafe_candidates cc
  JOIN public.dem_us r
    ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, cc.geom)
)
SELECT 
  poi_name,
  distance_meters,
  elevation_meters
FROM elevation_analysis
WHERE elevation_meters >= 200;
